title: The Distribution *Gap*
dek: Three frontier-class models arrived this week. None is simply available to anyone who asks.

stories.label: Introductory price per million input tokens
stories.headline: Gemini 4 Argon expands to paid API. The price has no end date.

stories.label: Parameters in Mistral Large 4
stories.headline: Mistral's 1T-parameter model has a preview. Its license does not exist yet.
Apple Intelligence arrives in China this fall. Alibaba's Qwen runs the models.

stories.label: Projected AI infrastructure hardware spend in 2026
stories.headline: OCP Summit closes today. The bottleneck has moved from GPUs to power and memory.

stories.label: Organizations signed Code of Practice on AI content transparency
stories.headline: EU Article 50 has been in force since August. Most enterprise deployers have not noticed.

still_signal: Three frontier models arrived, benchmarks barely separate them. Terms differ: staged access, unpublished license, partner model, compliance live, memory now the infrastructure bottleneck.
